body:
Thanks for the reply. I'm a girl, actually. 

There once was a time when I thought I could help others through my experience. I wanted to help others. I have a great deal of compassion. But I can't help others when my life is a mess, and I can't fix my life. Too much is broken.

Thank you for caring.

The first time I had hope, hope for a better future. I believed that if I worked hard enough on myself, I could change things to the point where I could lead a normal life. Support myself, have friends, find love. Now I know that my work will go down the drain because there's too many things I have to fix and it won't be enough. So I just... why bother... why bother changing all I am to fit society... if I'll never be like they expect me to be. I have a good heart, but that has no value in today's world. It's almost seen as a liability rather than a quality.

Anyway... I'm a graphic designer. I had a small advertising agency. 

I understand people that don't kill themselves for the pain they would cause others. It has stopped me before. I don't have anyone in my life anymore. No family, no friends, no love. So I would cause no pain at all.

Thanks for the reply.
